verdict.rationale: MX's docs say you can download its OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman. MX's GitHub repo (mxenabled/openapi) hosts the OpenAPI spec for the MX Platform API. The probe's 404s at well-known paths like /openapi.json don't contradict this, since the spec is published in the repo; they only show it isn't served at a conventional discovery URL. Missing for 10: spec served at a standard discoverable docs URL, independent verification of the spec's completeness and currency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: You can download our OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman to learn more about our API and its request and response payloads.
This repository contains the OpenAPI specification for the MX Platform API
